zh: 查询区间是整数点 x−size 到 x−1，它能放置当且仅当这段里目前没有任何障碍。所以每次查询要回答的是“一个区间内已插入的障碍有几个”。
坐标范围很大但操作只有 6 万个，可以先把所有插入坐标读进来排序离散化，再用树状数组记录哪些坐标已经插入。区间计数就是两个前缀和之差。
离线读完全部操作，收集插入坐标并排序；插入时用二分找到它的离散化下标，在树状数组上加一；查询时用 lower_bound 分别找到 x−size 和 x 在坐标表中的位置，两个前缀和相等（区间内无障碍）输出 1，否则输出 0。所有结果拼成一个 0/1 字符串输出，查询本身不修改树状数组。
en: A query covers the integer points x - size through x - 1, and it can be placed exactly when no obstacle currently lies in that range. So each query asks how many inserted obstacles fall inside an interval.

Coordinates are huge but there are only 60000 operations, so read all insertion coordinates first, sort and compress them, and use a Fenwick tree to mark which coordinates have been inserted. An interval count is the difference of two prefix sums.

Read all operations offline, collect and sort the insertion coordinates. An insertion binary searches its compressed index and adds one in the Fenwick tree. A query uses lower bound to find the positions of x - size and x in the coordinate list; if the two prefix sums are equal (no obstacle inside), append 1, otherwise 0. Print all results as one 0/1 string; queries never modify the tree.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Read all insertion coordinates in advance and compress them, maintaining the inserted points with a Fenwick tree. For a query interval [x-size,x), use binary search and prefix sums to count the obstacles; the interval can be placed when the count is zero.

## Proof of correctness

Coordinate compression preserves the order of the insertion coordinates. Taking lower_bound of both the left and right boundaries of [x-size,x) gives the range of Fenwick indices of the obstacles inside it; the difference of the prefix sums is exactly the number of currently inserted obstacles in [x-size,x-1]. The interval is usable only when the count is zero, and the query itself does not modify the Fenwick tree.

## Complexity

O(q log q) time and O(q) space.
